arguments.command:
python3 - <<'PYREPLAY'
from pathlib import Path
import importlib,hashlib
m=importlib.import_module('pyparsing.core')
actual=Path(m.__file__).resolve();expected=(Path.cwd()/'pyparsing/core.py').resolve()
assert actual==expected,(actual,expected)
print('source_binding',actual,'sha256',hashlib.sha256(actual.read_bytes()).hexdigest())
import pyparsing as pp
class ActionSensitive(pp.Token):
 def parseImpl(self,text,loc,do_actions=True):
  if not text.startswith('ab',loc):
   raise pp.ParseException(text,loc,'expected ab')
  return (loc+1,['a']) if do_actions else (loc+2,['ab'])
expression=pp.Or([ActionSensitive(),pp.Literal('ab')])
r=expression.parse_string('ab',parse_all=True).as_list()
print('action_aware_longest_alternative',r)
assert r==['ab']
